set.body:
Purpose

Make the existing compiled design and inference path carry structural scientific meaning rather than reconstructing it from names or offsets.

Scope

Evolve EventModel, DesignColmap, DesignBlock, FmriModel, FitPlan, fit results, result manifests, and compiled contrasts. Reuse ResponseBasis for basis-aware reconstruction.

Phase acceptance criteria

- [ ] Matrix, row layout, structural column schema, design audit, and fingerprint form one validated compiled-design authority.
- [ ] Each event, baseline, drift, intercept, sampled, and nuisance column has a stable structural origin; labels are rendered from that origin.
- [ ] Name/suffix parsing is removed from authoritative semantic paths and retained only in explicit compatibility adapters where required.
- [ ] Model and fit values preserve the design schema and fingerprint without duplicating parallel column truth.
- [ ] Compiled T/F hypotheses bind to structural columns and the design fingerprint and carry estimability evidence.
- [ ] Basis elements have stable identities and roles, and coefficient tests are distinct from response-level linear functionals.
- [ ] S07, S10, and S16 are active public-path scenarios on JVM and Scala.js.
- [ ] Existing formula, design export, fit, LSS, GLS, robust, and result-manifest behavior remains source-compatible where practical.
set.title: Phase 1: carry structural scientific identity through compilation and inference
